# Companion expected-bytes for valid_execute_nonutf8.json
#
# The execute payload's args[0] is a NativeString carrying a single non-UTF-8
# byte. On the wire it is the two-scalar escape U+E000 U+00FF (JSON:
# "ÿ"). Per the opi-protocol NativeString algorithm:
#   U+E000 introducer + U+00FF data scalar  ->  byte 0xFF
#
# Independent (non-Rust) clients can verify args[0] decodes to exactly these
# bytes:
#
#   args[0] = [0xFF]   (1 byte)
#
# args[1] is the plain ASCII string "ok":
#
#   args[1] = [0x6F, 0x6B]   (2 bytes, "ok")
